newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Pol Pot captured by ex-comrades, premier says.
newsitem.headline: Pol Pot captured by ex-comrades, premier says.

text.p: Cambodia's First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh said on Saturday Khmer Rouge guerrilla strongman Pol Pot had been captured by a group of his former followers.
Khmer Rouge radio, which is now controlled by a guerrilla splinter faction which broke with Pol Pot earlier this month, reported on Friday that it had captured Pol Pot. MORE rsb
"Yes, I confirm it. He has been captured already," Ranariddh told reporters. He did not elaborate.
Khmer Rouge radio said on Friday that the breakaway guerrilla faction's "national army" had captured Pol Pot the previous day.
Ranariddh said earlier this month that most of Pol Pot's supporters had turned against him and were hunting him down in the jungle of northern Cambodia.
He said Pol Pot had wanted to surrender to his former comrades-in-arms but his offer had been rejected. Instead he would be taken alive and brought to justice.
